title: Surrogate modeling for interpreting black-box LLMs in medical predictions

bias_targets.methodology: Using a surrogate modeling framework to generate simulated patient profiles, prompting LLMs for medical predictions (e.g., estimating glomerular filtration rate and pulmonary function), and applying linear regression to quantify the specific statistical weight (coefficients) the models assign to race variables to evaluate the persistence of scientifically refuted race-based clinical assumptions.
